issues.claim: A QR code can lose a quarter of itself and still scan.
issues.problem: 25% is Level Q (of codewords, not area); default/common level is M (~15%). Damage location matters: wiping a finder pattern breaks scanning regardless.
issues.fix: A QR code can lose a quarter of its data and still scan.

issues.claim: At the highest setting, thirty percent can be missing.
issues.problem: Level H restores ~30% of codewords, a theoretical figure (Wikipedia); not 30% of visible area anywhere.
issues.fix: At the highest setting, it can recover up to thirty percent of its data.

issues.claim: So a scuffed QR code usually still works.
issues.problem: Reasonable, but depends on level and on damage avoiding the three corner squares.
issues.fix: So a lightly scuffed QR code often still works, as long as the corners survive.
